name: CurvedLoop-TS-TW
title: Curved Loop
description: White uppercase words run continuously along a gently curved baseline and wrap around so the line never ends. The strip can be dragged to scrub the text, which then resumes in the direction you flick.
use: A section needs a wide moving strip of keywords or a looping brand statement.
avoid: Places where quiet reading matters: the constant motion competes with nearby copy.
a11y: Scrubbing needs a pointer, the strip never pauses, and there is no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: One long line of heavy white uppercase words, separated by small bullets, crosses a black stage along a shallow downward dip. The letters are large and tightly set and the line runs past both edges.
behaves: The line slides steadily to the left and loops seamlessly when it wraps. Dragging moves the text with the pointer and sets which way it carries on afterwards.
customise: The text, speed, direction, curve depth and whether dragging is allowed are props. Font size and weight sit in hardcoded SVG classes.
weight: light: A single SVG text path is nudged each frame; no canvas or heavy node count.
demo: Repeats "COMPONENTS • ANIMATIONS • DESIGN SYSTEM • OPEN SOURCE •".
polishWhy: Bold tight type and a smooth continuous arc; the curve is shallow enough to miss.
